# Fig 3A

-   ATAC and RNA integrated UMAPs

## ARC

```{r}
ARC <- readRDS("../Data.Objects/final_ARC_merged_clusters_20250206.rds")

```

```{r}
clusters <- c(0,3,17)

seu <- subset(ARC, tech=="RNA")

sig_RNA <- lapply(1:3, function(x){

  seu_sub <- subset(seu, condition %in% c("leptinARC3h", "ob"))
  seu_sub <- subset(seu_sub, clust_snRNA %in% clusters[x])
  Idents(seu_sub) <- "condition"
  
  dge_sub <- FindMarkers(seu_sub,
                         ident.1 = "ob",
                         ident.2 = "leptinARC3h",
                         only.pos = FALSE,
                         min.pct = 0,
                         logfc.threshold = 0,
                         min.diff.pct = -Inf,
                         return.thresh = 1)
  
  dge_sub_up <- dge_sub[dge_sub$avg_log2FC > 0,]
  dge_sub_down <- dge_sub[dge_sub$avg_log2FC < 0,]
  
  dge_sub_sig <- list("up"=dge_sub_up,
       "down"=dge_sub_down)          
  
  return(dge_sub_sig)
  
})
  
names(sig_RNA) <- paste0("clust_",as.character(clusters))

```

```{r}

seu_atac <- subset(ARC, tech=="ATAC")

sig_ATAC <- lapply(1:3, function(x){

  seu_sub <- subset(seu_atac, group %in% c("Leptin3hr", "OB"))
  seu_sub <- subset(seu_sub, clust_snRNA %in% clusters[x])
  Idents(seu_sub) <- "group"
  
  dge_sub <- FindMarkers(seu_sub,
                         ident.1 = "OB",
                         ident.2 = "Leptin3hr",
                         only.pos = FALSE,
                         min.pct = 0,
                         logfc.threshold = 0,
                         min.diff.pct = -Inf,
                         return.thresh = 1)
  
  dge_sub_up <- dge_sub[dge_sub$avg_log2FC > 0,]
  dge_sub_down <- dge_sub[dge_sub$avg_log2FC < 0,]
  
  dge_sub_sig <- list("up"=dge_sub_up,
       "down"=dge_sub_down)          
  
  return(dge_sub_sig)
  
})
  
names(sig_ATAC) <- paste0("clust_",as.character(clusters))


```

```{r}

sig_overlap <- lapply(1:3, function(x){
  ids_up <- intersect(rownames(sig_ATAC[[x]][[1]]),
                   rownames(sig_RNA[[x]][[1]]))
  ids_down <- intersect(rownames(sig_ATAC[[x]][[2]]),
                   rownames(sig_RNA[[x]][[2]]))
  out <- list(ids_up, ids_down)
  return(out)
  })

names(sig_overlap) <- paste0("clust_",as.character(clusters))

```

```{R}
# this is adapted from internal function in seurat

Melt <- function(x) {
  if (!is.data.frame(x = x)) {
    x <- as.data.frame(x = x)
  }
  return(data.frame(
    rows = rep.int(x = rownames(x = x), times = ncol(x = x)),
    cols = unlist(x = lapply(X = colnames(x = x), FUN = rep.int, times = nrow(x = x))),
    vals = unlist(x = x, use.names = FALSE)
  ))
}

```

### RNA + ATAC

```{R, fig3C.ARC.RNA_paired.heatmaps, fig.height=10, fig.width=15, dev=c('png', 'pdf'), fig.path='figures/figure3/fig3C.heatmaps/'}

seu <- subset(ARC, tech=="RNA")
seu_atac <- subset(ARC, tech=="ATAC")

for.plots <- clusters

clust_ord <- lapply(1:3, function(y){
  
  ######### up in OB RNA
  
  seu_temp <- seu[which(rownames(seu) %in% sig_overlap[[y]][[1]])]

  # make array of count data
  data <- as.data.frame(x = as.matrix(GetAssayData(object = seu_temp, slot = "data")))
  data2 <- Melt(x = t(x = data))
  data3 <- pivot_wider(data2, names_from = cols, values_from = vals)
  data3 <- as.data.frame(data3 )
  rownames(data3 ) <- data3 %>% pull(1)
  data3 <- data3[,-1]
  data3 <- t(data3)
  
  # grab metadata  
  my_meta <- data.frame(seu_temp$clust_snRNA, seu_temp$condition, seu_temp$tech)
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::filter(my_meta$seu_temp.tech == "RNA")
  colnames(my_meta)[1:2] <-  c("cluster", "group")
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC3h", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC24h", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "leptinARC72h", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin3hr", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin24hr", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin72hr", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "ob", "OB", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% for.plots[y])
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  my_meta_sub_rna <- my_meta_sub
  
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
  # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub.rna <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  
  seu_atac_temp <- seu_atac[which(rownames(seu_atac) %in% sig_overlap[[y]][[1]])]
  
  seu_temp <- seu_atac_temp
  data <- as.data.frame(x = as.matrix(GetAssayData(object = seu_temp, slot = "data")))
  data2 <- Melt(x = t(x = data))
  data3 <- pivot_wider(data2, names_from = cols, values_from = vals)
  data3 <- as.data.frame(data3 )
  rownames(data3 ) <- data3 %>% pull(1)
  data3 <- data3[,-1]
  data3 <- t(data3)
  
  # grab metadata  
  my_meta <- data.frame(seu_temp$clust_snRNA, seu_temp$group, seu_temp$tech)
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::filter(my_meta$seu_temp.tech == "ATAC")
  colnames(my_meta)[1:2] <-  c("cluster", "group")
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin3hr", "lep3h", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin24hr", "lep24h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "Leptin72hr", "lep72h", my_meta[,2]) 
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "ob", "OB", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- gsub( "wt", "WT", my_meta[,2])
  my_meta[,2] <- factor(my_meta[,2], levels=c("OB","lep3h","lep24h","lep72h","WT"))
  my_meta %<>% dplyr::arrange(cluster, group)
  my_meta_sub <- my_meta %>% filter(cluster %in% for.plots[y])
  my_meta_sub[,3] <- NULL
  my_meta_sub_atac <- my_meta_sub
  
  # reorder data to match the metadata
  data3_sub <- data3[,colnames(data3) %in% rownames(my_meta_sub)]
  for_plot <- data3_sub[,match(rownames(my_meta_sub),colnames(data3_sub))] 
  
    # filter rows with no counts
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot[!rowSums(for_plot)==0,]
  for_plot_sub <- for_plot_sub[apply(is.finite(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  for_plot_sub.atac <- for_plot_sub[apply(!is.na(for_plot_sub), 1, any),]
  
  common_names <- intersect(rownames(for_plot_sub.rna),rownames(for_plot_sub.atac))
  
  for_plot_sub.rna <- for_plot_sub.rna[rownames(for_plot_sub.rna) %in% common_names,]
  for_plot_sub.atac <- for_plot_sub.atac[rownames(for_plot_sub.atac) %in% common_names,]

  grps.rna <- unique(my_meta_sub_rna)
  for_plot.rna <- sapply(1:nrow(grps.rna), function(x){
      for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot_sub.rna[,which(my_meta_sub_rna[,1] == grps.rna[x,1] & my_meta_sub_rna[,2] == grps.rna[x,2])])
      return(for_out)
    })
  
  grps.atac <- unique(my_meta_sub_rna)
    for_plot.atac <- sapply(1:nrow(grps.atac), function(x){
      for_out <- rowMeans(for_plot_sub.atac[,which(my_meta_sub_atac[,1] == grps.atac[x,1] & my_meta_sub_atac[,2] == grps.atac[x,2])])
      return(for_out)
    })

    colnames(for_plot.atac) <- apply(grps.atac,1,paste0,collapse="_")
    rownames(grps.atac) <- colnames(for_plot.atac)
    colnames(for_plot.rna) <- apply(grps.rna,1,paste0,collapse="_")
    rownames(grps.rna) <- colnames(for_plot.rna)
    
  # plotting parameters
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(400)
  breaksList = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

  p2 <-  pheatmap(for_plot.rna,
                  main=paste0("Relative gene expression\n at DGE in cluster ",for.plots[y],"\n Expression aggregated within group\n Down in lep3h vs OB"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps.rna,
                  show_rownames = F,
                  cluster_cols = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,
                  color = colors)

  print(p2)
  p2_ord_up <- p2$tree_row$order
  names(p2_ord_up) <- rownames(for_plot.rna)
  
  ########### up in OB ATAC
  
  for_plot.atac <- for_plot.atac[p2_ord_up,]
    
  colors <- colorRampPalette(c('blue', 'white', 'red'))(400)
  breaksList = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.01)

  p2 <-  pheatmap(for_plot.atac,
                  main=paste0("Relative ATAC accesiblity\n at DGE in cluster ",for.plots[y],"\n Expression aggregated within group\n Down in lep3h vs OB"),
                  scale = "row",
                  annotation_col = grps.atac,

                  cluster_cols = F,
                  cluster_rows = F,
                  show_colnames = F,
                  treeheight_row=20,
                  labels_row = NULL,
                  breaks = breaksList,
                  color = colors)
  print(p2)
```
